name: Bond Blues
source:
It's 2026, and you're a bail bondsman in Burlington. A fully voiced visual novel exploring the obligations of duty, and what justice really means. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2786240/Bond_Blues/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
现在是2026年，你是伯灵顿的保释担保人。一部全语音视觉小说，探讨义务的义务以及正义的真正含义。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2786240/Bond_Blues/]Steam[/url]]
